newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates dip in liquid conditions.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates dip in liquid conditions.

text.p: Pakistan's money market rates dipped on Tuesday owing to liquid conditions, dealers said.

The market opened with overnight funds at 12 percent but a little activity took place at 8.00 percent and soon afterwards offers were coming in at 4.00 percent, where the major chunk of the activity took place, a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said.
A few lenders were unable to get rid of their funds because of very liquid conditions, he said.
